subject.why: The mail pouch is immediately recognisable, complete with its flap, buckle, shoulder strap, peeking envelope, and knotted blue bandana.

category.why: The pouch floats freely in three-quarter view with no ground or surface beneath it, framed by a smooth gradient background and a centred ring of theme motifs.

clean.why: There are no letters, numbers, watermarks, UI elements, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The pouch is well-centred with ample breathing room on all sides and a bold, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The rosy-pink background and warm leather tones are bright, saturated, and provide crisp contrast and separation.

detail.why: The shapes are kept simple and clean without micro-textures, scratches, or visual clutter.

style.why: Features the exact soft 3D casual game look with chunky rounded bevels, smooth shading, and a gentle satin sheen consistent with the references.

bg_colour.why: background is pink (96% of the background); planned pink
